fieldSemantics.finalPosts: drift-checks.mjs:296,320: number of reply rounds with non-null final check; denominator, not count of markers
fieldSemantics.finalOnLastPost: drift-checks.mjs:224,321: count whose last event matches a durable Run final marker

limits: No final marker is a real explicit-final efficiency criterion failure, not missing business publication: normal post plus ACK and natural native completion can be valid.
Standing protocol says MAY explicitly add --final only for completed work, not MUST on every successful post; the stricter final95 is this gate criterion.
No inference that reported generation count equals HTTP requests or price.
Read-only diagnostic extraction proves argument presence, not a new substitute for Worker authentication/ACK.

privatePreservation.format: native JSONL; scoped OpenCode session/message/part rows from one read transaction; consistent temporary daemon SQLite backups

limits: Manual post-hoc review of individual stochastic answers; errors do not establish product-induced quality degradation.
Model binding/effort are gate metadata except independently inspected Kimi llm.request; do not claim verified backend weights.
Actual HTTP request totals unknown for providers without direct request evidence; reported generation count is not HTTP count.
Cancelled Kimi llm.request without usage remains unknown cost; no zero-cost inference.
Running arms remain provisional and raw hashes may change until finishedAt.
Quality rubric is post-hoc manual source review, not pre-registered scoring; explicitly conditional hardening proposals are not current-code factual failures.
Known reported usage is retained for all failures; missing or cancelled-request usage is unknown, never billed zero.
Differences across arms include answer content/length, actual routes and cache ordering; ratios are descriptive only.
